body:
Reported Player(s): ChilledChaos 

Rules Broken: Swapped teams, and started to destroyed the defense on the team he was currently on.

Sidenote: If pictures aren't enough proofs for teamgreifing, I'll just upload videos next time. If you have any suggestions for a good video recorder, I'll gladly use it. 

Evidence: 

I'll start off by putting chat pictures where he says he swapped/changed teams to greif the Orange team so the green team can win. I was spectating the match and he was originally green team.


Sapped=swapped


This is him breaking some of the defensive walls protecting the obsidian.
